head: BugMeNot shut down after more than 20 years
dek: BugMeNot, the site where people shared logins for websites that force you to register, has closed. Its homepage now only says it has closed and thanks everyone who envisioned a better internet; no reason was given.
details: Australian developer Guy King started BugMeNot in August 2003, at first without giving his name. Its creators later launched the coupon site RetailMeNot in 2006. The closing page also shows a block of letter groups that look random.
means: If you used BugMeNot to skip sign-up forms on news sites and forums, those shared logins are no longer available there.
todo: Nothing to do. If you signed up for sites with your own email instead, a password manager keeps those logins in one place.
